version.author: Giorgio Robino
version.changelog: 0.8.0 The package moved from MIDI/ccscope to ccscope, so ReaPack installs it in Effects/ccscope and sees a different package: remove the old one after updating, and re-add the effect to projects that used it. Also a shorter description, no sliders mentioned (hidden since 0.7.0), and the roadmap left to the issues and discussions. 0.7.8 CC ramps draw as straight diagonals instead of an artificial staircase; genuine peaks, troughs and clipped boundaries remain. 0.7.7 Nothing visible changed: one conductor plus five library files, so a change touches one file. Update through ReaPack. 0.7.6 History spans the whole chosen time window at any event rate, and changing WIN keeps what was retained. Spikes stay as an envelope. Limits and validation: GitHub issue #5. 0.7.5 Less work per frame, same picture: cheaper redraws on busy sessions. Capacity and GUI refresh rate unchanged. GitHub issue #23. 0.7.4 The control bar spans the plot, flush left and right, with cut corners; the engaged button turns amber. Narrow windows put the two buttons after the selectors. 0.7.3 The bar sits on the window's own black, aligned with the plot's left edge: one vertical line through the whole plugin. 0.7.2 The three metrics are fixed columns with right-aligned numbers, so a changing value no longer shifts what follows it. 0.7.1 No change in behaviour: a packaging fix, 0.7.0 shipped with the previous release notes. 0.7.0 The plugin draws its own control bar, seven cells in place of the slider strip, which cost 190 px of window height. Automation, presets and the Param button keep working. 0.6.5 The "now" edge of the graph is a single line: no tick on the frame. 0.6.4 The pair list can sit beside the plot, roughly doubling the pairs a short, wide window shows; too narrow a window falls back and says so. 0.6.3 A taller window shows more pairs, not only a taller graph; the status line says how many are on screen. 0.6.2 Channel filter, combining with the CC filter: graph, bars and the "showing N of M" line read the same filtered list. 0.6.1 Packaging fix: 0.6.0 could not load. Use 0.6.1 or newer. 0.6.0 Renamed to CCScope (was "MIDI CC Visualizer"): uninstall the old package. One colour per (CC, channel), labelled time axis, Freeze and Clear, DOTS as a choice, and metrics corrected: exactly one second, 500 events/s per pair, jitter that ignores gaps. 0.5.2 Correctness pass, no new features: CC values from 10 upwards no longer overwrote each other's data, one filter for graph and bars, and jitter measured on the audio-sample clock. 0.5.1 Cleaner bar layout: explicit Events/Rate/Jitter labels. 0.5 Multi-channel support: CC data, colours and metrics tracked per (CC, channel).
